The production-safe fix for the **Automated Incremental Satellite Monitoring Workflow** under **Option A (Latest Observation Only)** has been implemented, verified via automated regression tests, and validated with a live end-to-end execution against Google Earth Engine for the Sathiyar zone (`sathiyar`, `ZONE-260906-7064`). For full technical details, diagrams, and logs, see the updated [walkthrough.md](file:///C:/Users/jayaseelan/.gemini/antigravity/brain/0fa06343-02c9-4e30-bff2-c98f7b170b82/walkthrough.md). --- ### Root Cause & Resolution Summary 1. **Root Cause**: In [AutomatedMonitoringService.ts](file:///d:/tn-enforcement-system/tn-forest-monitoring/server/src/services/AutomatedMonitoringService.ts), converting the search start date to `"2020-01-09"` caused GEE daily-granularity queries to return the active baseline scene as Candidate #1. Because there was no candidate pre-filter gate, the loop immediately passed Candidate #1 to `processObservationPipeline()`, where an internal baseline guard threw an uncaught error. This aborted the loop and prevented the remaining 32 valid scenes from ever being processed, causing `Discovered: 0, Processed: 0, Alerts: 0`. 2. **Pre-Filtering Gate**: Added pre-filter checks with diagnostic counters (`baselineRejectedCount`, `temporalRejectedCount`, `cloudRejectedCount`, `sensorRejectedCount`, `duplicateRejectedCount`). 3. **Option A Enforcement**: Eligible candidates are sorted by acquisition date descending; **only the single newest observation** is selected and processed. Historical intermediate candidates are skipped. 4. **Resilient Pipeline & Real Export Integration**: Wrapped execution in try/catch and integrated [SatelliteAcquisitionService.exportSatelliteRaster](file:///d:/tn-enforcement-system/tn-forest-monitoring/server/src/services/SatelliteAcquisitionService.ts) for authentic GEE raster export, Google Drive download, and GeoTIFF validation. --- ### 22-Item Diagnostic Verification Table (Live Sathiyar Execution) | # | Metric / Verification Field | Authentic Live Execution Value | Status | Affected Area: **0.13%** (0.13 ha), Severity: **NONE** | **PASS** | | **21** | Incremental Record ID & State | `JOB-33469214` / `COMPLETED` | **PASS** | | **22** | Baseline Immutability Verified | **YES (UNMODIFIED)**: Baseline `6a9d80eba10b3f9de22fe3f4` date remains `2020-01-09T05:25:55.755Z` and status remains `ACTIVE` | **PASS** | --- ### Monitored Area UI View Status In the UI (Monitoring Jobs table), Sathiyar now displays: - **Last Processed Sensing Date**: `2021-04-28` - **Latest Observation**: `...20210428T052121_T43PHM` - **Alert Severity**: `NONE` - **Status**: `COMPLETED` Subsequent clicks on "Run Incremental Scan" will now return `WAITING_FOR_NEW_OBSERVATION` (`Discovered: 0, Processed: 0, Alerts: 0`) as the zone is now fully up to date. --- ### Automated Regression Suite The automated test suite at [incremental-monitoring-latest-only.test.ts](file:///d:/tn-enforcement-system/tn-forest-monitoring/server/src/tests/incremental-monitoring-latest-only.test.ts) ran **38/38 scenarios with 100% pass rate**, confirming: - Exact rejection of baseline image ID, pre-baseline timestamps, cloud $>20\%$, sensor mismatch, and completed duplicates. - Option A strict selection of exactly one newest observation. - Clean waiting states without phantom database entries. - Active baseline immutability and complete multi-tenant zone isolation. - Error classification (transient vs permanent) and token redaction. - All 22 user accounts and authentication credentials preserved.
